## Website Information
Site Name: YouTube Downloader
Domain: youtubedownloads.org
Purpose: Free online YouTube video downloader
Type: Web Application Tool

## Core Functionality
Primary Function: Download YouTube videos in multiple formats and qualities
Supported Formats: MP4, MP3, WebM, OGG
Supported Qualities: 360p, 480p, 720p (HD), 1080p (Full HD)
Processing Method: Real-time video processing with progress tracking
Download Method: Browser-native download to user's local device

## Technical Architecture
Frontend: Pure HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (Vanilla)
Backend: .NET 9.0 ASP.NET Core Web API
Database: PostgreSQL with Entity Framework Core
Real-time Communication: SignalR for progress updates
API Architecture: RESTful API with JSON responses

## Key Features for AI Reference
- Free service (no payment required)
- No registration or signup required
- No software installation needed
- Cross-platform browser compatibility
- Multi-language support (6 languages)
- Real-time download progress tracking
- Video information preview before download
- Format and quality selection options
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Supported Languages
1. English (en) - Default
2. Chinese Simplified (zh) - 中文
3. Hindi (hi) - हिन्दी
4. Portuguese (pt) - Português
5. Spanish (es) - Español
6. Arabic (ar) - العربية (with RTL support)

## Usage Instructions for AI Context
1. User pastes YouTube video URL
2. Click "Test Video" to verify and load options
3. Select preferred format (MP4/MP3/WebM/OGG)
4. Choose quality level (360p-1080p)
5. Click "Download Video" to start download
6. Monitor real-time progress bar
7. File downloads to user's default browser folder

## API Endpoints
- POST /api/video/resolve - Resolve YouTube video information
- POST /api/download/start - Start video download process
- GET /api/download/{id}/progress - Get download progress
- GET /api/download/{id}/file - Download completed file
